title: Commission Calculator
description: Calculate sales commission with tiered rate brackets you can edit.
howto: Edit the tier brackets: each row sets the sales "up to" amount and its rate. Leave the last "up to" empty for no cap.
Add or remove tiers as needed.
Read the commission earned in each bracket plus the total and effective rate.

faqs.a: Each portion of sales is paid at the rate of the bracket it falls in, like marginal tax brackets. Only the sales inside a bracket earn that bracket's rate.

faqs.q: What does an empty 'Up to' mean?
faqs.a: An empty cap means no upper limit, so that tier catches all remaining sales. It is normally the last row.
No. Brackets are applied in ascending order of their caps, and overlapping caps are rejected with an error.
